LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_FIVE.lessonTitleEnglish: How Do We Get to the Hotel?
LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_FIVE.learnerPromise: Describe two qualities or abilities that are true at the same time.
LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_FIVE.explanation: Put 又 before each of two qualities or actions describing the same subject; do not put nouns directly after 又.
LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_FIVE.pattern: Person or thing + 又 + quality 1 + 又 + quality 2

patternRows.english: Taipei MRT is both fast and convenient.
He can both sing and paint.

items.question: Does each quality need 又?
items.answer: Put 又 before 快 and again before 方便.

right.traditional: 台北的捷運又快又方便。
right.pinyin: Táiběi de jiéyùn yòu kuài yòu fāngbiàn.
right.english: Taipei MRT is both fast and convenient.
right.simplified: 台北的捷运又快又方便。

items.question: Can 又 stand before 他?
items.answer: Put 又 before each ability, after the subject 他.

right.pinyin: Tā yòu huì chànggē yòu huì huàhuà.
right.english: He can both sing and paint.

discoveryLab.title: Balance the two sides
discoveryLab.description: Each 又 opens one matching description. Both sides describe the same person or thing.

choices.label: Example 1
choices.traditional: 我同學的妹妹又可愛又漂亮。
choices.simplified: 我同学的妹妹又可爱又漂亮。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ tóngxué de mèimei yòu kě’ài yòu piàoliang.
choices.english: My classmate’s younger sister is both cute and pretty.
choices.note: Find 又 before each quality or action.

choices.label: Example 2
choices.traditional: 我現在又餓又渴，想喝一點兒茶、吃一點兒飯。
choices.simplified: 我现在又饿又渴，想喝一点儿茶、吃一点儿饭。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài yòu è yòu kě, xiǎng hē yìdiǎnr chá, chī yìdiǎnr fàn.
choices.english: I am both hungry and thirsty right now; I want to drink some tea and eat a little rice.
choices.note: Find 又 before each quality or action.

choices.label: Example 3
choices.traditional: 他又想去日本，又想去韓國，不知道應該先去哪國。
choices.simplified: 他又想去日本，又想去韩国，不知道应该先去哪国。
choices.pinyin: Tā yòu xiǎng qù Rìběn, yòu xiǎng qù Hánguó, bù zhīdào yīnggāi xiān qù nǎ guó.
choices.english: He wants to go to Japan and also wants to go to Korea; he does not know which country to visit first.
choices.note: Find 又 before each quality or action.

discoveryLab.takeaway: One person or thing, two matching 又 blocks.

text.english: He wants to go to Japan and also wants to go to Korea; he does not know which country to visit first.

LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_FOUR.lessonTitleEnglish: How Do We Get to the Hotel?
LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_FOUR.learnerPromise: Name an activity first, then comment on it.
LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_FOUR.explanation: In Chinese, you can say the activity first, then say what you think about it. Think: activity → your comment.

patternRows.english: Taking the MRT is very convenient.

columns.meaning: we all like it very much

patternRows.english: Playing soccer, we all like (it) very much.

items.question: Can I split 坐捷運 with the comment?
items.answer: Keep the activity 坐捷運 together before 很方便.

right.pinyin: Zuò jiéyùn hěn fāngbiàn.
right.english: Taking the MRT is very convenient.

items.question: Does 都 go after 喜歡?
items.answer: Put 都 before 喜歡 in the comment 我都喜歡.
items.wrongTraditional: 跑步、游泳、打網球，我喜歡都。

right.traditional: 跑步、游泳、打網球，我都喜歡。
right.simplified: 跑步、游泳、打网球，我都喜欢。
right.pinyin: Pǎobù, yóuyǒng, dǎ wǎngqiú, wǒ dōu xǐhuan.
right.english: Running, swimming, and playing tennis — I like them all.

discoveryLab.title: Put the activity on stage
discoveryLab.description: The first chunk is what we are talking about; the rest is the comment.

choices.label: Example 1
choices.traditional: 走路去太慢了！
choices.simplified: 走路去太慢了！
choices.pinyin: Zǒulù qù tài màn le!

choices.note: Read the activity before its comment.

choices.label: Example 2
choices.traditional: 唱歌、跳舞都很有趣。
choices.simplified: 唱歌、跳舞都很有趣。
choices.pinyin: Chànggē, tiàowǔ dōu hěn yǒuqù.
choices.english: Singing and dancing are both very interesting.
choices.note: Read the activity before its comment.

choices.label: Example 3
choices.traditional: 跑步、游泳、打網球，我都喜歡。
choices.simplified: 跑步、游泳、打网球，我都喜欢。
choices.pinyin: Pǎobù, yóuyǒng, dǎ wǎngqiú, wǒ dōu xǐhuan.
choices.english: Running, swimming, and playing tennis — I like them all.
choices.note: Read the activity before its comment.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Activity first, comment second. You do not need 是 between them.

LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.lessonTitleEnglish: How Do We Get to the Hotel?
LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.titleEnglish: 從 and 到: From and To
LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.learnerPromise: Say where someone comes from and where they go.
LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.explanation: 從 means from. 到 means to. Put the place right after it, then end with 來 (come) or 去 (go).
LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.pattern: Subject + 從 / 到 + place + 來 / 去

items.question: Which place follows 從?
items.answer: Put the starting place after 從 and the destination after 到.
items.wrongTraditional: 我到學校從我家去上課。

right.traditional: 我從我家到學校去上課。
right.pinyin: Wǒ cóng wǒ jiā dào xuéxiào qù shàngkè.
right.english: I go to school from my home for class.
right.simplified: 我从我家到学校去上课。

items.question: He is coming to my home; 來 or 去?
items.answer: Use 來 because the trip ends at the speaker’s home.
items.wrongTraditional: 他從旅館到我家去吃飯。

right.traditional: 他從旅館到我家來吃飯。
right.simplified: 他从旅馆到我家来吃饭。
right.pinyin: Tā cóng lǚguǎn dào wǒ jiā lái chīfàn.
right.english: He is coming from the hotel to my home to eat.

items.question: Where does 去 go in 到他家去?
items.answer: Put 去 after 到 and the destination: 到他家去.

right.pinyin: Wǒ dào tā jiā qù.
right.english: I went to his place.

routeLab.title: Read the book routes

choices.label: Visit home
choices.traditional: 他從旅館到我家來吃飯。
choices.simplified: 他从旅馆到我家来吃饭。
choices.pinyin: Tā cóng lǚguǎn dào wǒ jiā lái chīfàn.
choices.english: He is coming from the hotel to my home to eat.
choices.note: Read the starting place and destination.

choices.label: Buy milk tea
choices.traditional: 他從學校到飲料店去買珍珠奶茶。
choices.simplified: 他从学校到饮料店去买珍珠奶茶。
choices.pinyin: Tā cóng xuéxiào dào yǐnliào diàn qù mǎi zhēnzhū nǎichá.
choices.english: He goes from school to the drink shop to buy pearl milk tea.
choices.note: Read the starting place and destination.

choices.label: Visit Taiwan
choices.traditional: 他今天從韓國到台灣來看朋友。
choices.simplified: 他今天从韩国到台湾来看朋友。
choices.pinyin: Tā jīntiān cóng Hánguó dào Táiwān lái kàn péngyǒu.
choices.english: He came from Korea to Taiwan today to visit a friend.
choices.note: Read the starting place and destination.

routeLab.takeaway: Pins stay paired: 從 + start, 到 + destination. 來/去 shows which way the trip points, not the vehicle.

text.traditional: A：你從哪裡來？ B：我從飯店來。
text.simplified: A：你从哪里来？ B：我从饭店来。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ cóng nǎlǐ lái? B: Wǒ cóng fàndiàn lái.
text.english: A: Where are you coming from? B: From the hotel.

text.traditional: A：你到哪裡去？ B：我到咖啡廳去。
text.simplified: A：你到哪里去？ B：我到咖啡厅去。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ dào nǎlǐ qù? B: Wǒ dào kāfēitīng qù.
text.english: A: Where are you going? B: I am going to the café.

text.traditional: A：他到圖書館去嗎？ B：他不到圖書館去，他到朋友家去。
text.simplified: A：他到图书馆去吗？ B：他不到图书馆去，他到朋友家去。
text.pinyin: A: Tā dào túshūguǎn qù ma? B: Tā bú dào túshūguǎn qù, tā dào péngyǒu jiā qù.
text.english: A: Is he going to the library? B: He is not going to the library; he is going to his friend’s place.

text.traditional: 他從旅館到我家來吃飯。
text.simplified: 他从旅馆到我家来吃饭。
text.pinyin: Tā cóng lǚguǎn dào wǒ jiā lái chīfàn.
text.english: He is coming from the hotel to my home to eat.

text.traditional: 他從學校到飲料店去買珍珠奶茶。
text.simplified: 他从学校到饮料店去买珍珠奶茶。
text.pinyin: Tā cóng xuéxiào dào yǐnliào diàn qù mǎi zhēnzhū nǎichá.
text.english: He goes from school to the drink shop to buy pearl milk tea.

text.traditional: 他今天從韓國到台灣來看朋友。
text.simplified: 他今天从韩国到台湾来看朋友。
text.pinyin: Tā jīntiān cóng Hánguó dào Táiwān lái kàn péngyǒu.
text.english: He came from Korea to Taiwan today to visit a friend.

LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.lessonTitleEnglish: How Do We Get to the Hotel?
LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.learnerPromise: Say that something is new or has changed.
LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.explanation: 了 at the end of a sentence means something is new: it was not true before, but it is now.

items.question: Where does 了 go with 餓?
items.answer: Put 了 after 餓 to show the new state.

right.pinyin: Wǒ è le.
right.english: I am hungry now.

items.question: Where does 了 go in 可以上車了?
items.answer: Put 了 after the whole action 可以上車.

right.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ shàngchē le.
right.english: We can get on the bus now.

items.question: Can 不可以 follow the action here?
items.answer: Put 不可以 before 玩手機 to say it is no longer allowed.
items.wrongTraditional: 上課了，老師來了，我們玩手機不可以了。

right.traditional: 上課了，老師來了，我們不可以玩手機了。
right.simplified: 上课了，老师来了，我们不可以玩手机了。
right.pinyin: Shàngkè le, lǎoshī lái le, wǒmen bù kěyǐ wán shǒujī le.
right.english: Class has started and the teacher is here; we cannot play on our phones anymore.

discoveryLab.title: Ring the change bell
discoveryLab.description: See the moment when a state becomes true for the first time.

choices.label: Example 1
choices.traditional: 我餓了，想吃一點東西。
choices.simplified: 我饿了，想吃一点东西。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ è le, xiǎng chī yìdiǎn dōngxi.
choices.english: I am hungry; I want to eat something.
choices.note: Read 了 at the end of the new situation.

choices.label: Example 2
choices.traditional: 孩子都累了，我們一起休息吧！
choices.simplified: 孩子都累了，我们一起休息吧！
choices.pinyin: Háizi dōu lèi le, wǒmen yìqǐ xiūxí ba!
choices.english: The children are all tired; let us take a rest together!
choices.note: Read 了 at the end of the new situation.

choices.label: Example 3
choices.traditional: 啊！現在十點了！我的錶慢了。
choices.simplified: 啊！现在十点了！我的表慢了。
choices.pinyin: Ā! Xiànzài shí diǎn le! Wǒ de biǎo màn le.
choices.english: Oh! It is ten o’clock now! My watch is slow.
choices.note: Read 了 at the end of the new situation.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Use 了 when "now it is different" matters.

text.traditional: 我餓了，想吃一點東西。
text.simplified: 我饿了，想吃一点东西。
text.pinyin: Wǒ è le, xiǎng chī yìdiǎn dōngxi.
text.english: I am hungry; I want to eat something.

text.traditional: 孩子都累了，我們一起休息吧！
text.simplified: 孩子都累了，我们一起休息吧！
text.pinyin: Háizi dōu lèi le, wǒmen yìqǐ xiūxí ba!
text.english: The children are all tired; let us take a rest together!

text.traditional: 啊！現在十點了！我的錶慢了。
text.simplified: 啊！现在十点了！我的表慢了。
text.pinyin: Ā! Xiànzài shí diǎn le! Wǒ de biǎo màn le.
text.english: Oh! It is ten o’clock now! My watch is slow.

text.traditional: 你十五歲了，應該學做飯了。

text.traditional: A：請你明天早上九點來。 B：好，我知道了，謝謝。
text.simplified: A：请你明天早上九点来。 B：好，我知道了，谢谢。

LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.lessonTitleEnglish: How Do We Get to the Hotel?
LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.titleEnglish: 怎麼: How You Get There
LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.learnerPromise: Ask and say how someone travels.
LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.explanation: Ask with 怎麼 (how). Answer with how you travel, like 坐公車, 騎腳踏車 or 走路, then 來 or 去.
LESSON_SEVEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.pattern: Subject + travel method + 來 / 去

patternRows.english: How do you get there?
I get there by bus.

items.question: Do I use 坐 with 走路?
items.answer: Use 走路 for walking, without 坐.
items.wrongTraditional: 我不要坐走路去，我要坐捷運去。

right.traditional: A：你要走路去嗎？ B：我不要走路去，我要坐捷運去。
right.simplified: A：你要走路去吗？ B：我不要走路去，我要坐捷运去。
right.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào zǒulù qù ma? B: Wǒ bú yào zǒulù qù, wǒ yào zuò jiéyùn qù.
right.english: A: Are you going to walk? B: I am not going to walk; I am going by MRT.

items.question: Does the travel method go before 去?
items.answer: Put 坐公車 before 去 when it answers how you travel.

right.pinyin: Wǒ zuò gōngchē qù.
right.english: I get there by bus.

items.question: Where does 怎麼 go?
items.answer: Put 怎麼 before 去 to ask how you get there.

right.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme qù?
right.english: How do you get there?

text.traditional: A：你們怎麼來？ B：我們騎腳踏車來。
text.simplified: A：你们怎么来？ B：我们骑脚踏车来。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐmen zěnme lái? B: Wǒmen qí jiǎotàchē lái.
text.english: A: How are you all coming? B: We are coming by bicycle.

text.traditional: A：你要走路去嗎？ B：我不要走路去，我要坐捷運去。
text.simplified: A：你要走路去吗？ B：我不要走路去，我要坐捷运去。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào zǒulù qù ma? B: Wǒ bú yào zǒulù qù, wǒ yào zuò jiéyùn qù.
text.english: A: Are you going to walk? B: I am not going to walk; I am going by MRT.

text.traditional: A：他坐公車到學校去嗎？ B：不，他坐計程車到學校去。
text.simplified: A：他坐公车到学校去吗？ B：不，他坐计程车到学校去。

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: How Do We Get to the Hotel?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: 從 and 到: From and To
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say where someone comes from and where they go.
grammarPages.explanation: 從 means from. 到 means to. Put the place right after it, then end with 來 (come) or 去 (go).
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 從 / 到 + place + 來 / 去

items.question: Which place follows 從?
items.answer: Put the starting place after 從 and the destination after 到.
items.wrongTraditional: 我到學校從我家去上課。

right.traditional: 我從我家到學校去上課。
right.pinyin: Wǒ cóng wǒ jiā dào xuéxiào qù shàngkè.
right.english: I go to school from my home for class.
right.simplified: 我从我家到学校去上课。

items.question: He is coming to my home; 來 or 去?
items.answer: Use 來 because the trip ends at the speaker’s home.
items.wrongTraditional: 他從旅館到我家去吃飯。

right.traditional: 他從旅館到我家來吃飯。
right.simplified: 他从旅馆到我家来吃饭。
right.pinyin: Tā cóng lǚguǎn dào wǒ jiā lái chīfàn.
right.english: He is coming from the hotel to my home to eat.

items.question: Where does 去 go in 到他家去?
items.answer: Put 去 after 到 and the destination: 到他家去.

right.pinyin: Wǒ dào tā jiā qù.
right.english: I went to his place.

routeLab.takeaway: Pins stay paired: 從 + start, 到 + destination. 來/去 shows which way the trip points, not the vehicle.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: How Do We Get to the Hotel?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: 怎麼: How You Get There
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Ask and say how someone travels.
grammarPages.explanation: Ask with 怎麼 (how). Answer with how you travel, like 坐公車, 騎腳踏車 or 走路, then 來 or 去.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + travel method + 來 / 去

patternRows.english: How do you get there?
I get there by bus.

items.question: Do I use 坐 with 走路?
items.answer: Use 走路 for walking, without 坐.
items.wrongTraditional: 我不要坐走路去，我要坐捷運去。

right.traditional: A：你要走路去嗎？ B：我不要走路去，我要坐捷運去。
right.simplified: A：你要走路去吗？ B：我不要走路去，我要坐捷运去。
right.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào zǒulù qù ma? B: Wǒ bú yào zǒulù qù, wǒ yào zuò jiéyùn qù.
right.english: A: Are you going to walk? B: I am not going to walk; I am going by MRT.

items.question: Does the travel method go before 去?
items.answer: Put 坐公車 before 去 when it answers how you travel.

right.pinyin: Wǒ zuò gōngchē qù.
right.english: I get there by bus.

items.question: Where does 怎麼 go?
items.answer: Put 怎麼 before 去 to ask how you get there.

right.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme qù?
right.english: How do you get there?

text.traditional: A：你們怎麼來？ B：我們騎腳踏車來。
text.simplified: A：你们怎么来？ B：我们骑脚踏车来。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐmen zěnme lái? B: Wǒmen qí jiǎotàchē lái.
text.english: A: How are you all coming? B: We are coming by bicycle.

text.traditional: A：你要走路去嗎？ B：我不要走路去，我要坐捷運去。
text.simplified: A：你要走路去吗？ B：我不要走路去，我要坐捷运去。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào zǒulù qù ma? B: Wǒ bú yào zǒulù qù, wǒ yào zuò jiéyùn qù.
text.english: A: Are you going to walk? B: I am not going to walk; I am going by MRT.

text.traditional: A：他坐公車到學校去嗎？ B：不，他坐計程車到學校去。
text.simplified: A：他坐公车到学校去吗？ B：不，他坐计程车到学校去。
text.pinyin: A: Tā zuò gōngchē dào xuéxiào qù ma? B: Bù, tā zuò jìchéngchē dào xuéxiào qù.
text.english: A: Is he taking the bus to school? B: No, he is taking a taxi to school.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: How Do We Get to the Hotel?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something is new or has changed.
grammarPages.explanation: 了 at the end of a sentence means something is new: it was not true before, but it is now.

items.question: Where does 了 go with 餓?
items.answer: Put 了 after 餓 to show the new state.

right.pinyin: Wǒ è le.
right.english: I am hungry now.

items.question: Where does 了 go in 可以上車了?
items.answer: Put 了 after the whole action 可以上車.

right.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ shàngchē le.
right.english: We can get on the bus now.

items.question: Can 不可以 follow the action here?
items.answer: Put 不可以 before 玩手機 to say it is no longer allowed.
items.wrongTraditional: 上課了，老師來了，我們玩手機不可以了。

right.traditional: 上課了，老師來了，我們不可以玩手機了。
right.simplified: 上课了，老师来了，我们不可以玩手机了。
right.pinyin: Shàngkè le, lǎoshī lái le, wǒmen bù kěyǐ wán shǒujī le.
right.english: Class has started and the teacher is here; we cannot play on our phones anymore.

discoveryLab.title: Ring the change bell
discoveryLab.description: See the moment when a state becomes true for the first time.

choices.label: Example 1
choices.traditional: 我餓了，想吃一點東西。
choices.simplified: 我饿了，想吃一点东西。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ è le, xiǎng chī yìdiǎn dōngxi.
choices.english: I am hungry; I want to eat something.
choices.note: Read 了 at the end of the new situation.

choices.label: Example 2
choices.traditional: 孩子都累了，我們一起休息吧！
choices.simplified: 孩子都累了，我们一起休息吧！
choices.pinyin: Háizi dōu lèi le, wǒmen yìqǐ xiūxí ba!
choices.english: The children are all tired; let us take a rest together!
choices.note: Read 了 at the end of the new situation.

choices.label: Example 3
choices.traditional: 啊！現在十點了！我的錶慢了。
choices.simplified: 啊！现在十点了！我的表慢了。
choices.pinyin: Ā! Xiànzài shí diǎn le! Wǒ de biǎo màn le.
choices.english: Oh! It is ten o’clock now! My watch is slow.
choices.note: Read 了 at the end of the new situation.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Use 了 when "now it is different" matters.

text.traditional: 孩子都累了，我們一起休息吧！

dialogue.title: 對話一 · Dialogue 1
dialogue.setting: 學校的下課休息時間 · Break time at school

text.traditional: 元真，我們明天幾點去找妳的韓國朋友？
text.simplified: 元真，我们明天几点去找你的韩国朋友？
text.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, wǒmen míngtiān jǐ diǎn qù zhǎo nǐ de Hánguó péngyǒu?
text.english: Yuanzhen, what time are we going to meet up with your Korean friends tomorrow?

text.traditional: 我們下午四點要到天美飯店，她在那裡等我們。
text.simplified: 我们下午四点要到天美饭店，她在那里等我们。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sì diǎn yào dào Tiānměi Fàndiàn, tā zài nàlǐ děng wǒmen.
text.english: We have to arrive at Tianmei Hotel at 4 in the afternoon. She will wait for us there.

text.traditional: 我們要怎麼去？坐捷運還是坐公車？
text.simplified: 我们要怎么去？坐捷运还是坐公车？
text.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zěnme qù? Zuò jiéyùn háishì zuò gōngchē?
text.english: How do we get there? By MRT or bus?

text.traditional: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。
text.simplified: 听说那家饭店不远，我想我们可以从学校走路去。
text.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā fàndiàn bù yuǎn, wǒ xiǎng wǒmen kěyǐ cóng xuéxiào zǒulù qù.
text.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

text.traditional: 可是我不知道怎麼走，妳知道嗎？
text.simplified: 可是我不知道怎么走，你知道吗？
text.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ bù zhīdào zěnme zǒu, nǐ zhīdào ma?
text.english: But I don’t know how to get there, do you?

text.traditional: 我也不知道。我們可以先上網看地圖。
text.simplified: 我也不知道。我们可以先上网看地图。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yě bù zhīdào. Wǒmen kěyǐ xiān shàngwǎng kàn dìtú.
text.english: I don’t know either. We can check the map online first.

text.traditional: 啊！上課了！我們先上課吧。
text.simplified: 啊！上课了！我们先上课吧。
text.pinyin: Ā! Shàngkè le! Wǒmen xiān shàngkè ba.
text.english: Ah! The class has started! Let’s go to class now.

text.traditional: 好。
text.simplified: 好。
text.pinyin: Hǎo.
text.english: Okay.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Name an activity first, then comment on it.

items.question: Does 都 go after 喜歡?

text.english: Running, swimming, and playing tennis — I like them all.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: How Do We Get to the Hotel?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe two qualities or abilities that are true at the same time.
grammarPages.explanation: Put 又 before each of two qualities or actions describing the same subject; do not put nouns directly after 又.
grammarPages.pattern: Person or thing + 又 + quality 1 + 又 + quality 2

patternRows.english: Taipei MRT is both fast and convenient.
He can both sing and paint.

items.question: Does each quality need 又?
items.answer: Put 又 before 快 and again before 方便.

right.traditional: 台北的捷運又快又方便。
right.pinyin: Táiběi de jiéyùn yòu kuài yòu fāngbiàn.
right.english: Taipei MRT is both fast and convenient.
right.simplified: 台北的捷运又快又方便。

items.question: Can 又 stand before 他?
items.answer: Put 又 before each ability, after the subject 他.

right.pinyin: Tā yòu huì chànggē yòu huì huàhuà.
right.english: He can both sing and paint.

discoveryLab.title: Balance the two sides
discoveryLab.description: Each 又 opens one matching description. Both sides describe the same person or thing.

choices.label: Example 1
choices.traditional: 我同學的妹妹又可愛又漂亮。
choices.simplified: 我同学的妹妹又可爱又漂亮。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ tóngxué de mèimei yòu kě’ài yòu piàoliang.
choices.english: My classmate’s younger sister is both cute and pretty.
choices.note: Find 又 before each quality or action.

choices.label: Example 2
choices.traditional: 我現在又餓又渴，想喝一點兒茶、吃一點兒飯。
choices.simplified: 我现在又饿又渴，想喝一点儿茶、吃一点儿饭。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài yòu è yòu kě, xiǎng hē yìdiǎnr chá, chī yìdiǎnr fàn.
choices.english: I am both hungry and thirsty right now; I want to drink some tea and eat a little rice.
choices.note: Find 又 before each quality or action.

choices.label: Example 3
choices.traditional: 他又想去日本，又想去韓國，不知道應該先去哪國。
choices.simplified: 他又想去日本，又想去韩国，不知道应该先去哪国。
choices.pinyin: Tā yòu xiǎng qù Rìběn, yòu xiǎng qù Hánguó, bù zhīdào yīnggāi xiān qù nǎ guó.
choices.english: He wants to go to Japan and also wants to go to Korea; he does not know which country to visit first.
choices.note: Find 又 before each quality or action.

discoveryLab.takeaway: One person or thing, two matching 又 blocks.

dialogue.title: 對話二 · Dialogue 2
dialogue.setting: 看地圖決定怎麼去飯店 · Reading the map to decide how to get to the hotel

text.traditional: 友美，妳看，天美飯店在大學路。我現在知道怎麼走了。
text.simplified: 友美，你看，天美饭店在大学路。我现在知道怎么走了。
text.pinyin: Yǒuměi, nǐ kàn, Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài Dàxué Lù. Wǒ xiànzài zhīdào zěnme zǒu le.
text.english: Look, Youmei. Tianmei Hotel is on Daxue Road. Now I know how to get there.

text.traditional: （看地圖）啊！天美飯店在這裡！我知道這個地方，附近有郵局跟超級市場。
text.simplified: （看地图）啊！天美饭店在这里！我知道这个地方，附近有邮局跟超级市场。
text.pinyin: (Kàn dìtú) A! Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài zhèlǐ! Wǒ zhīdào zhè ge dìfang, fùjìn yǒu yóujú gēn chāojíshìchǎng.
text.english: (Looking at the map) Ah! So here is Tianmei Hotel! I know this place. There is a post office and a supermarket nearby.

text.traditional: 我想走路去一定沒問題。
text.simplified: 我想走路去一定没问题。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zǒulù qù yídìng méi wèntí.
text.english: I think it will certainly be okay going there on foot.

text.traditional: 可是我覺得那裡有點兒遠，走路去太累了。
text.simplified: 可是我觉得那里有点儿远，走路去太累了。
text.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde nàlǐ yǒudiǎnr yuǎn, zǒulù qù tài lèi le.
text.english: But I think it’s a bit far. It’s too tiring to get there on foot.

text.traditional: 妳想怎麼去？
text.simplified: 你想怎么去？
text.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zěnme qù?
text.english: How do you want to get there?

text.traditional: 坐捷運又方便又舒服，我們可以坐捷運。
text.simplified: 坐捷运又方便又舒服，我们可以坐捷运。
text.pinyin: Zuò jiéyùn yòu fāngbiàn yòu shūfu, wǒmen kěyǐ zuò jiéyùn.
text.english: Taking the MRT is convenient and comfortable. We can take the MRT.

text.traditional: 好，我們明天坐捷運去吧。
text.simplified: 好，我们明天坐捷运去吧。
text.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen míngtiān zuò jiéyùn qù ba.
text.english: Ok, let’s take the MRT to get there tomorrow.

comprehension.hint: Find the paired qualities in Youmei’s answer.
